title: v2: Parakeet v3 model bundle and 'High-accuracy transcript' setting
description: Prepare the optional high-accuracy final pass (PRD goal 6): add the multilingual Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 offline model to the catalog, a setting to enable it, and download it through the existing setup screen.
steps: In `models/ModelCatalog.kt` add `ModelKind.ASR_OFFLINE` and `val PARAKEET = ModelBundle(id = "asr-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8", displayName = "High-accuracy transcription (Parakeet v3)", kind = ASR_OFFLINE, language = null, files = ..., asr = AsrFiles("encoder.int8.onnx", "decoder.int8.onnx", "joiner.int8.onnx", "tokens.txt", modelType = "nemo_transducer"))`, base URL `https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8/resolve/main/`, files (name, size): `encoder.int8.onnx` 652184281, `decoder.int8.onnx` 11845275, `joiner.int8.onnx` 6355277, `tokens.txt` 93939. Add it to `all`.

Change `requiredFor(language: String, accurateFinalPass: Boolean = false)` to append PARAKEET when the flag is true. Update all callers (`MainActivity`, home FAB, `ModelSetupViewModel` factory, Settings model status) to pass `settings.accurateFinalPass`.
Add `val accurateFinalPass: Boolean = false` to `AppSettings`, persisted by `SettingsRepository` like the other fields.

In `SettingsScreen` Transcription section add a `Switch` row "High-accuracy final transcript" with supporting text "After recording, re-transcribe each speaker turn with a larger model (English, French and 23 other European languages). Downloads 670 MB; slower to finish." When switched on and PARAKEET is not installed, navigate to `setup` (which now includes it). Add a "Delete high-accuracy model" text button when installed and the switch is off (`modelStore.delete(PARAKEET)`). Add Parakeet v3 (CC-BY-4.0, NVIDIA) to the About licences list and README.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `PARAKEET.totalBytes == 670478772` and `requiredFor("en", true)` ends with `asr-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8` while `requiredFor("en")` does not contain it
Test: with EN models installed and the flag on, the setup ViewModel requests only the Parakeet bundle
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
